named_subject: a wave or swell of water, drawn as a stack of long horizontal strokes that come to a point on the right
action: The stack of strokes slides steadily from the lower left to the lower right along the base of the grey house, keeping the same shape throughout.
identity_gap: The animated figure is the same layered, right-pointing scribble as c.png, only smaller, with the same strokes and construction.
notes: The film shows surf breaking and churning against the front of a house, with the large breaking wave on the left in frames 1 to 7 and calmer water after; the animation only translates one rigid shape rightward, so the surge, break and settling are missing. The change that would help most is to make the strokes rise, curl and flatten in time with the film's wave breaking against the house instead of sliding as a fixed block.
